transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. I came in because... well, my mind just will not hold onto things anymore. I'll sit down to write a simple note for the youth maker program—something I could do in my sleep before—and the numbers and words just scatter on me. I just can't seem to think clearly.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling persistently sad, down, or have you lost interest in the things you usually enjoy?

Yes, I have. Most days I wake up with this... heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It just stays with me. Even when my wife is talking kindly to me, I just feel like I'm sitting at the bottom of a well. So, yes, I've been feeling very down.
Have you ever felt this way for a significant period of time in the past, or is this the first time you have experienced these feelings?

No, I don't think I have. This is... this is really the first time. I mean, I've had bad days over the years, sure, but nothing like this. It's never just stayed with me, day after day, like this heavy feeling has. So, yeah, this is the first time I've ever experienced anything quite like this.
Have you noticed any new physical symptoms, such as headaches, vision changes, or changes in your energy levels, that started around the same time as this difficulty with your thinking?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. No headaches or... or vision changes. I mean, my energy is pretty low, but I think that's mostly just from feeling so weighed down all the time. But as far as actual physical symptoms go, no, I haven't had anything new pop up.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or your sleep patterns since this heavy feeling started?

Yes, my appetite has definitely changed. Food has mostly just lost its appeal for me. I usually just sit there and push my breakfast around the plate... and by supper time, my wife is reminding me that I've barely eaten anything all day. I just don't have much interest in it right now.
And how have you been sleeping lately?
My sleep? It's... I haven't really noticed any changes there, to be honest. I guess I'm sleeping about the same as I always do. Nothing really stands out to me about it.
Have you noticed if you are moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or conversely, do you feel restless and unable to sit still?

Yeah, it's definitely the first one. I haven't been restless at all, but... everything I do has just slowed way down. 

Whether it's just trying to get out of my chair or... or even just answering a question right now, it takes effort. It honestly feels like my whole body, and even my tongue, are just moving through wet cement.
